identity.name: The Hindu
identity.description: An Indian English-language newspaper of record published by The Hindu Group, with strong national politics, foreign affairs and South Indian coverage.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Owned by the Kasturi family through Kasturi & Sons Limited and associated family shareholders. A longstanding Indian newspaper institution with a professional newsroom.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Family-owned newspaper with a strong editorial-independence tradition and critical coverage of Indian governments.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: Historically liberal-left editorial tradition; MBFC page exists but no clean bias fields were parsed.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is policy-analytic and heterogeneous, not consistently pro-market.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames foreign policy through Indian strategic autonomy and democratic institutions.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC credibility High; established newspaper of record with named sourcing and corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC page exists; no parsed bias/factual fields, credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Indian newspaper-of-record voice. Explains national politics and foreign policy through legal-institutional and South Indian lenses, with a liberal editorial tradition.

selectionRationale: Adds a high-quality Indian national perspective and South Asian depth beyond wire coverage.

feeds.feedTitle: World News: Latest International News & Updates | The Hindu

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. Ownership verified through the August 2026 Kasturi & Sons announcement and Media Ownership Monitor. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
